observationalLimits: Agent generated descriptive visual observations; raw screenshots are held inside the TinyFish run, not copied into this GitHub library.
First/second live reports disagree about trainer name and arena. Personal trainer identifiers omitted; N's Castle third run is grounded by visible DOM.
3v3 practice uses live server queue; it is not a local offline simulation.
No complete enumeration of every Pokémon, move animation, arena layout or online features.
Cross Poison 'No effect' is a single encounter result, not proof of universal type immunity.
Sprite/VFX source assets not duplicated or redistributed. Only cataloged metadata.
Cooldown unit/seconds, frame counts, physical hitboxes and battle rendering performance not measured.
No REA injection into authenticated TinyFish browser; it remains separate, public JS static research.
